result.reason: The clause does not reach the preferred position because Vendor may still assign without consent to a financially responsible affiliate and there is no prohibition on assignment to a Customer competitor. It also does not reach the fallback, which requires mutual successor-assignment rights with written notice; the successor carve-out applies only to Client and contains no notice requirement. The edits otherwise preserve the clause’s commercial structure and are generally well drafted, but adding “reorganization” and “or delayed” goes beyond the stated positions while required protections remain omitted. The margin comment cannot cure these operative-language deficiencies.
